cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Make It Their Idea
cards.instruction: Make an unwanted task sound appealing enough that someone volunteers for it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. These eighty wedding place cards need names. Your bin labels have better lettering than our invitations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I like calligraphy. I hate copying guest lists.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I'd read the names. You'd only do the beautiful part.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your aunt will complain if I use purple.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll handle my aunt. The ink colour could be entirely yours.

mechanism: A copies a printer's confident vocabulary while making a dull labeling job sound like a desirable specialist role.
confusable: S03 knows procedure; S04 parrots corrections without admitting ignorance while D05 still seeks a volunteer.
comparison: Production craft/status lure contrasts with a club storage reward.
seedUse: Use D05-a separating enjoyable lettering from copying and S04 defensive reinterpretation of mistakes.
